title: bayespk 0.2.0
text: Bug fix: error = "log", likelihood compared untransformed DV log(concentration), log-scale fits 0.1.0 0.1.1 wrong. DV now log-transformed. recovery test simulation-based calibration scenario log-scale error added. Data quantification limit: rows CENS = 1 (DV holds limit) handled Beal’s M3 method. Steady state: dose records SS = 1 II use closed-form steady-state solutions bolus, infusion first-order oral doses; earlier doses reset, observations within one interval steady-state dose (troughs) used. dose_regimen(ss = TRUE) predicts steady state. mean/deviation split random effects longer applied KA, slower without benefit benchmarks (inst/validation/benchmark_decouple.R).

title: bayespk 0.1.1
text: plot() methods: individual fits fine time grid, observed vs predicted, trace plots, predicted concentrations new regimens compare = two regimens. use Okabe-Ito colours. predict() without regimen accepts times return subject’s prediction time grid. Predictions returned class bpk_prediction (data frame). prior_sensitivity() reports parameters names (CL, b_wt, omega_V, …). New simulated data set bpk_example, used every example. Three vignettes precomputed results figures: getting started, covariates informative priors, two-compartment models regimen comparison. citation("bayespk"), issue templates, README figures results.

title: bayespk 0.1.0
text: First release: 1- 2-compartment linear models (IV bolus, infusion, first-order oral), closed-form solutions, log-normal -subject variability (optionally correlated), covariate formulas, four residual error models, weakly informative default priors, diagnostics warnings, predictions new regimens, prior sensitivity. pk_model(ka_faster = TRUE) constrains typical KA disposition rate remove flip-flop modes (default). Random effects sampled sample mean plus Helmert deviations, removes correlation typical values mean random effect.
